description: Use for a quick synchronous search when the user supplies one natural-language brief and can wait for results in the current tool call. For durable progress, retry, export, or large agent workflows, use start_lead_search instead.

brief.description: Example: Independent veterinary clinics in Berlin with an active first-party website. Exclude directories and chains.

fields.description: Business fields to retain. Website and source evidence remain available for verification.

geography.description: Optional explicit geography. Use when the brief does not make location clear.

includeDiagnostics.description: Include source status and explained exclusions.

limit.description: Maximum businesses in this response page.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset for this response page.

output.description: Compact minimizes tokens. Full preserves every returned field.

name: research_businesses

diagnostics.description: Source status and explained candidate exclusions.

hasMore.description: Whether another result page is available.

limit.description: Maximum prospects requested for this page.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next synchronous result page, or null when complete.

requestId.description: Request identifier for support and diagnostics.

resultCount.description: Total accepted prospects before response pagination.

returnedCount.description: Prospects returned in this response page.

searchedSources.description: Discovery and first-party source types consulted.

warnings.description: Limitations the agent should retain with downstream data.
